name: communitycad-mcp
description: Find real parts on CommunityCAD, read their datasheets and download CAD files into your design.
long_description: Search CommunityCAD for real, dimensionally accurate parts: vendor components, hardware and community models. Read datasheets, comments and accuracy scores, and save STEP, STL and other CAD files to a folder your CAD tool can open. Downloads follow the same limits as the website. Sign in from the chat by asking Claude to link your CommunityCAD account.
